Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

MVBeliefUpdatr 0.1.0

Initial release of MVBeliefUpdatr, a package for modeling, fitting, and visualizing incremental Bayesian categorization and belief updating for Gaussian ideal observers and ideal adaptors.

Key Features

S7 Class Architecture

  • Unified hierarchy for cognitive models based on R’s modern ‘S7’ class system.
  • Separation of concerns across:
    • MVBU_CategoryRepresentation: category distribution representations for univariate Gaussian (UVG), multivariate Gaussian (MVG), and univariate Gaussian with category-specific variance (MUVG).
    • MVBU_CategoryTemplate: collections of category representations representing an observer’s prior or updated beliefs.
    • MVBU_CognitiveModel: ideal observers, ideal adaptors, and exemplar-based categorization models.

Bayesian Belief Updating & Conjugate Hyperpriors

  • Analytical closed-form Bayesian belief updating under conjugate hyperprior distributions:
    • Normal-Inverse-Chi-squared (NIX) for 1D cues.
    • Normal-Inverse-Wishart (NIW) for multivariate cues.
    • Multivariate Normal-Inverse-Chi-squared (MNIX) for multivariate cues with diagonal covariance matrices.
  • Support for four moment-updating regimes per category:
    • Unknown prior mean and unknown prior variance/covariance (Case 1).
    • Unknown prior mean and known prior variance/covariance (Case 2).
    • Known prior mean and unknown prior variance/covariance (Case 3).
    • Known prior mean and known prior variance/covariance (Case 4).
  • Declarative prior specification with parameter_prior(), supporting informative Normal, Cauchy, LKJ, Beta, and Dirichlet priors.
  • Partial and global parameter fixing with fix_parameter().

Stan Integration & MCMC Parameter Inference

  • Pre-compiled Stan models providing full Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) parameter estimation for univariate and multivariate Gaussian ideal adaptors.
  • Integration with ‘loo’ for Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation model comparison via loo(), waic(), and loo_compare().
  • Tidy extraction methods (get_parameters(), get_draws(), get_predictions()) supporting both natural cue space and standardized space.

Visualization Suite

  • Rich visualization tools built with ‘ggplot2’ and ‘patchwork’:
    • plot_categories(): 1D density profiles, 2D ellipses, and 3D sliced hypersurfaces.
    • plot_categorization_functions(): posterior categorization functions along continuous cue dimensions.
    • plot_parameters(): multi-panel posterior distributions and updating trajectories.
